module "T_SampleLevel.dss"

product 0 Material "M_SampleLevel" backend=Graph
  %0 = Reflected[TextureCoordinate](CoordinateIndex=0) : float2 @L6:C17 "UV"
  %1 = TextureParameter(ParameterName="Tex", SortPriority=0) : Texture2D @L2:C1 "Tex"
  %2 = Constant(Value=(0)) : float @L7:C43 "EmissiveColor"
  %3 = TextureSample(%1, %0, _, %2, MipValueMode="MipLevel") : [RGBA:float4, R:float, G:float, B:float, A:float] @L7:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %4 = Swizzle(%3, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L7:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %5 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%4) @L4:C1
  sink %5
